metadata.note: Strip all powers of 2 in one step: for even n, repeatedly halve until odd. Equivalent to applying T exactly v_2(n) times. This is the 'jump' Collatz map. WARNING: the redefinition is NOT a single T step; it is the composition T^{v_2(n)}. It only agrees with the conjecture at the level of orbits, not steps. Mismatch in examples is intentional and documents this.
